suppress.notes: False positive: CVE-2022-31691 is a Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Spring Tool Suite 4 (STS4) YAML editors for Eclipse/VSCode extensions, not in the spring-boot-devtools runtime library itself. Reference: https://spring.io/security/cve-2022-31691/

False positive: CVE-2025-7962 is an SMTP injection vulnerability in the angus-mail component (Jakarta Mail reference implementation), not in angus-activation (Jakarta Activation reference implementation), which is a separate project with independent versioning. Reference: https://github.com/dependency-check/DependencyCheck/issues/8130

False positive: CVE-2025-15104 affects "Nu Html Checker" (validator.nu), an unrelated HTML validation tool (CWE-918 SSRF). The generic CPE cpe:2.3:a:validator:validator:* collided with hibernate-validator's artifact name; there is no relationship between the two projects. Reference: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-15104
